sources.finding: Qwen3.5-4B exposes image/video tokens and a 24-layer vision encoder with hidden size 1024, output hidden size 2560, patch size 16 and spatial merge size 2.
Official model card describes Qwen3.5-4B as a 4B causal language model with Vision Encoder and image-text-to-text usage.

Qwen3-VL exposes visual-agent, spatial grounding, OCR, video and token-budget capabilities, supporting direct study of native multimodal control rather than assuming an external semantic Retina stack.

Qwen provides a dedicated multimodal embedding/reranking family with an explicit retrieval representation objective and unified text/image/screenshot/video space; this is counterevidence to assuming raw base-VLM visual states are automatically calibrated familiarity embeddings.
Current Transformers implementation exposes a distinct vision path before language-model generation, preserving a physical interception surface for representation experiments.
